interface.name: slot_session
interface.description: The client stages slot rectangles with set_slot, then commit makes that staged layout live

entry.name: pointer_mode
entry.summary: cursor handling: 0 hides it, 1 lets it interact

request.name: set_slot
request.description: Set the rectangle for slot N. Nothing moves until the next commit.

request.name: set_option
request.description: Applies immediately, whether or not you have committed.

request.name: commit
request.description: Swap the live layout for whatever is currently staged.

request.name: end
request.description: Ends the session and destroys this object.
